en: Sepia-toned vintage street scene showing a narrow village road lined with single- and two-story buildings with verandas and arcades. People are walking and standing along the sides, some goods or crates are stacked near the buildings, and an animal (likely a donkey) is visible in the middle distance. At the bottom of the image there is printed caption text indicating the location and description of the scene, and a website watermark is overlaid across the image.
